Explain that lexical tone does not establish entity-specific sentiment, publication timing or a calibrated financial prediction. If VADER is unavailable, retain that failure.

prompts.title: Paper-test with costs
prompts.prompt: Run backtest.costed_bars on my frozen document using examples/costed-bar-replay.json as the template. Preserve as_of, currency, asset class, initial cash, quantity step, all bar and signal availability times, spread/slippage/fee basis points, fixed fee, participation and carry-or-cancel policy. Fill only at opens strictly after both the source close and signal availability, using prior available volume as a liquidity proxy. Reconcile partial fills, fees, cash, held position and final pending quantity; do not invent final liquidation or observed liquidity.

prompts.title: Replay all six portable examples
prompts.prompt: Run the unchanged fictional examples/portable-workbench.json through scripts/quant_workbench.py prepare, run and verify. Preserve each job document and the shared contract; save prepared inputs and the first result bundle in new files outside the installed skill folder. Show the outcome of all six operations, hashes and runtime versions, retaining errors and unavailable dependencies. A replayed rejection is not a successful calculation. Explain the examples as method checks, not market history or investment-performance evidence.

prompts.title: Compare models on the same frozen packet
prompts.prompt: Prepare examples/portable-workbench.json once and compare Codex, Muse and Claude on that exact input-only packet and identical prompt, using the same skill candidate in fresh participant contexts. Withhold other participants' answers, accepted answers and correctness feedback. Preserve every first response, error, input hash and runtime version; verify calculations locally after collection. Report correct agreement separately from shared mistakes, interpretation differences and execution limits. Label comparisons exploratory when memory, blinding or environments differ; do not replace a failed attempt.

prompts.title: Continue when an optional library is missing
prompts.prompt: Check the requirements of my requested portable operations in this host. When an optional library is missing, preserve the explicit DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE outcome and identify the affected operations. Continue unrelated bundled calculations that can actually run, retaining their inputs and outputs separately. Do not install packages, switch models, substitute another method or contact a backend. Tell me which work remains uncomputed and the local dependency it requires.

prompts.title: Execute and verify a supplied request
prompts.prompt: Run [REQUEST.json] through the installed single-command offline workflow in a new private directory. Preserve the original inputs, report actual execution and verification, and build the numerical answer from generated facts. Keep incomplete work and host export limitations explicit.

prompts.title: Keep sale proceeds distinct from costs
prompts.prompt: Using [TRADE REQUEST], calculate gross sale value, transaction costs and net proceeds. Preserve their distinct generated labels, units and result pointers in both the table and final explanation. Do not call costs spendable proceeds.

prompts.title: Separate selected order from affordable maximum
prompts.prompt: For [ORDER INPUTS], report the selected quantity and its debit and remaining cash separately from the maximum affordable quantity and its own debit and remainder. Distinguish per-share cost rates from aggregate costs.

prompts.title: Check concentration with an incomplete account
prompts.prompt: Using [ACCOUNT INPUTS], distinguish known dollar exposure, known-equity concentration and full-account concentration. Retain numerator and denominator completeness and justify any bound explicitly. If unknown assets could change both, report the concentration as unresolved rather than choosing a bound direction.

prompts.title: Compare hash scopes before claiming equality
prompts.prompt: Compare [HASH DESCRIPTORS] using their algorithms, canonicalization and exact object scopes. Do not equate contract identity with full-input identity. Report incompatible scopes, missing metadata and different digests separately.

prompts.title: Audit execution and export evidence
prompts.prompt: Review [RETAINED RUN RECORDS] without editing them. Separate synthetic historical invocation records, observed current execution, numerical replay and files actually collected. Check active package version consistency and preserve any failure or unavailable export.
